spans.s: विधर्मक possessed of different phone- tic properties.
विधल् tad. affix विध applied to the words भौरिकि and others in the Sense of 'inhabited country'; e.g. भौरिकि- विधः, वैपेयविध:; cf. Kas. on
विधा characteristic feature of an activity; cf. संख्याया विधार्थे धा Í विधा प्रकारः सर्वकियाविषय एव गृह्यते Kas. on
विधान (I) prescription, statement; cf लोपे हि ( प्रत्ययलक्षण-) विधानम् P.I.
; (2) instrument or cause of an activity; cf. विधिवि- धानावधिभाजां त्रयाणां संनिधाने तदन्तविधेि- र्भवति Siradeva
विधारण mention of a consonant as intact i.e. without any phonetic coalescence or संधि; the same as अाभनिधान. The term is used in this sense in the Pratisakhya works.
विधि (l) a prescriptive rule ; cf. तत्र अपूर्वो विधिरस्तु नियमोस्तु इत्यपूर्वं एव विधि- र्भधेिप्यति न नियम: M.Bh.on
; ct also समर्थः पदविधिः । विपूर्वाद्वाञ: कर्म- साधन इकार: विधीयते विधेरिति M.Bh.on
: (2) prescription, state- ment; injunction; cf. अस्ति भावसा- धन: । विधानं वेिधि: | M.Bh. on

विधिबलीयस्त्व the superior strength of an injunctive rule; the term is very frequently used by gramma- rians in speaking about the rela- tive strength of rules; cf the term लेापाविधिबलीयस्त्व. M.Bh. on
विधिवाक्य an injunctive statement or sentence.
विधेय (l) predicate as constrasted with उद्देश्य; cf.समर्थाधिकारस्य विधेयसामाना- धिकरण्यनियमेनर्थकः M.Bh. on
: (2) that which should be prescribed as contrasted with प्रतिषेध्य: cf. तिङ् च कश्चिद्विडधेयः कश्चित् प्रातषेध्य: M.Bh. on
विध्यादि the senses headed by विधि as given in the rule विधिनिमन्त्रणामन्त्रणाधी- ष्टसंप्रश्नप्रार्थनेषु लिङ्
I ; cf. विध्यादिषु सप्तमी च Kat.
; cf. also विध्यादिषु क्रियाथिल्लिङ् भवति Candra Vyak.

विधेयकवाक्यता forming one single state- ment or idea with the prescriptive statement: union with the prescrip- tive rule so as to form one rule with it. The term is used in conn- ection with प्रतिषेध or prohibitive assertions which have to be ex- plained in combination with the prescriptive sentences or vidhi- vakyas; cf. निषेधवाक्यानामपि निषेध्य- विशेषाकाङ्क्षत्वाद्विध्येकवाक्यतयैवान्वयः Par. Sek. on
